structure.unit: State Corporation Commission; Surety Bonds on Employees; Transportation of Explosives, Convicts and Insane Persons

law.catch_line: Penalty for failure to make necessary repairs, etc
law.text: If any railroad, or other railroad company, when directed by a valid order of the Commission, refuses or fails to comply with any requirement imposed pursuant to § 56-129.1, such company shall, in the discretion of the Commission, be fined in accordance with federal guidelines.
